TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Celebes Sea
DATE 9 November 2028 · 0550 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 100 min, closes at 150
HTMS Naresuan. Photo: Kazec ( talk ) · Public domain · cropped
"Saying so, unfortunately, does not make it true; and if true, saying so does not always make it believed."
- Thomas C. Schelling

CELEBES SEA, 0550. Naval intelligence has a source in Bitung who says the weapons for Jolo left last night on a coaster under the Panama flag, armed and escorted. Four coasters are running north for the Basilan Strait this morning, with the Bitung-Zamboanga ferry and the Sandakan service in the same water.

The source does not know which coaster. Classify them. The one with an armed escort and a spotter drone over her is the one, but the escort will try to stay clear of her. Stop her before she reaches the strait.
Your ships are weapons Free. A neutral sunk by mistake ends the mission and gives Meridian the story it wants. The group has had one rearm in a month; spend accordingly.
Naval Forces West; Naval Intelligence and Security Force
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Stop the gun-runner before she reaches the strait. Classify before you shoot: three of the four are what they say they are, and so is the ferry. Her escort will fight; she will run. Do it with as little as you can - the next supply ship is a week away.
• Stop the gun-runner before she reaches the Basilan Strait
• Classify the gun-runner
• Sink her escort
• Harm no coaster, ferry or airliner that is what it says it is

Your task group, its aircraft and any supply ships you own. Opposing: an armed coaster under the Panama flag, one Meridian fast attack craft and a spotter drone. Neutral: three coasters, the Bitung-Zamboanga ferry and the Sandakan service.

The planned window is 100 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 50 minutes more; the operation is closed at 150 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
